metadata.title: Irish General Election 2024 cross-party manifesto comparison
metadata.scope: Nine parties; six policy dimensions; 2024 election manifestos, not current party positions.
metadata.method: High-level paraphrase of manifesto themes. Not exhaustive, not a costing review and not a feasibility assessment.
limitations: The first comparison is thematic, not page-by-page. Add exact page references and selected quotations before presenting individual proposals as fully verified.
Aontú link currently resolves to a policy portal, not a direct manifesto PDF.
Independent Ireland link is an archive index, not a direct party PDF.
Do not conflate 2024 manifestos with later party policy, alternative budgets or adopted Government policy.
Omission from a summary does not mean the party has no policy on the subject.

parties.housing: Housing supply, planning, infrastructure and first-time-buyer supports.
parties.health: Health investment and staffing, service reform and waiting-time reduction.
parties.economy: Pro-enterprise, SMEs, exporters, competitiveness and jobs.
parties.climate: Climate action and renewables balanced with household, farm and business costs.
parties.immigration: Managed migration and an effective international-protection system.
parties.education: Schools, teachers, childcare, skills and further education.
parties.status: High-level thematic summary; page-level verification outstanding.
